headline: Sri Lanka Customs achieves over 59-pct of November 2026 target in 16 days
summary: Sri Lanka Customs has achieved over 59% of its November 2026 revenue target in 16 days. Analysts expect customs revenue to reach a fresh record above 2,700 billion rupees in 2026.
why: Customs revenue is a major source of government income in Sri Lanka and reflects the level of imports flowing through its ports.
